services.name: Dolphin Tours
services.desc: Our personalized dolphin tours will have you near these amazing creatures within minutes. We are very sensitive to dolphin behaviors, and unlike larger tours, our excursions are smaller and more intimate. We do not scare or harass the dolphins, and many of our local pods have learned to trust our team. Feel the thrill of riding a Yamaha VX Deluxe Jet Ski while getting up close to wild dolphins in their natural habitat. Our jetskis are 2-seaters, up to 400lbs or 3-seaters up to 350lbs. 3-seaters are dependent on water conditions day by day, guest safety always comes first!
